title: Distinguishing Flat and Warped Extra Dimensions with Unruh-DeWitt Detectors
summary: We examine the response of a two level Unruh-DeWitt (UD) detector interacting with the Kaluza-Klein (KK) mass modes of a bulk scalar field in extra dimensional models. Considering two of the promising extra dimensional models with distinct compactifications, such as large, flat extra dimensions in the Arkani Hamed, Dimopoulos \& Dvali (ADD) framework and warped extra dimensions in the Randall-Sundrum (RS) scenario, we compute the profile function of the detector.
